# FastGrid and FastSheet by COQsoft

> Official resources for FastGrid, a high-performance JavaScript data grid, and
> FastSheet, a browser-based web spreadsheet using the same FGridE.js runtime.

## Products

- [FastGrid](https://www.treegrid.com/FastGrid): JavaScript and TypeScript data
  grid for large datasets, virtual scrolling, editing, sorting, filtering,
  grouping, pivoting, tree data, export and AI-assisted operations.
- [FastSheet](https://www.treegrid.com/FastSheet): Web spreadsheet for XLSX,
  CSV, formulas, workbook editing and large sheets.

## Framework integrations

- [Angular](https://www.treegrid.com/FDoc/FastGridAngular.html):
  `fastgrid-angular`, `create-fastgrid-angular`
- [React](https://www.treegrid.com/FDoc/FastGridReact.html):
  `fastgrid-react`, `create-fastgrid-react`
- [Vue](https://www.treegrid.com/FDoc/FastGridVue.html):
  `fastgrid-vue`, `create-fastgrid-vue`
- [Svelte](https://www.treegrid.com/FDoc/FastGridSvelte.html):
  `fastgrid-svelte`, `create-fastgrid-svelte`
- [HTML and JavaScript](https://www.treegrid.com/FDoc/FastGridHtml.html):
  `create-fastgrid-html`

## Licensing summary

The framework wrappers, generators and example source code are open source.
The FastGrid/FastSheet runtime `FGridE.js` is commercially licensed. Public npm
packages contain a trial runtime for evaluation; registered runtimes are
supplied separately.
